name: delulu-lang
description: DeluluLang language support — one LSP server for every editor (`delulu lsp`).

scripts.package: npm test && npm run licence && npm run build && vsce package --out delulu-lang.vsix && npm run unstage-licence

delulu.serverPath.markdownDescription:
Path to the `delulu` binary (the server is `delulu lsp`).

This setting is **machine-scoped**: a workspace cannot set it. That is deliberate — the extension launches this path as a process the moment a `.delulu` file is opened, so a repository that could set it would get code execution on clone-and-open.

delulu.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the traffic between the editor and the language server to the **DeluluLang** output channel. Use `verbose` when reporting a bug: it records every request and response, which is the difference between "completion doesn't work" and a report someone can act on.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Analysis (highlighting, diagnostics, hover) runs in an untrusted workspace. Running and testing do not: those execute the workspace's own code.
